svg.title: Identity and secret delivery
svg.desc: People authenticate through Gitea OIDC. Kubernetes workloads use namespaced service-account identities.

g.text: People authenticate through Gitea OIDC. Kubernetes workloads use namespaced service-account identities.
Login to Vault or Argo CD
Gitea subject 2: administrator in both services. Other users: Vault sign-in-only; Argo CD read-only.
Workload authentication • ESO in external-secrets namespace
2–3. Login + KV read; short-lived Vault token
cert-manager/vault-auth → eso-cert-manager → Cloudflare token for cert-manager
argocd/vault-auth → eso-argocd → confidential Gitea web-client secret for Argo CD
vault-secrets/vault-auth → eso-vault-secrets → demo prefix only; example is optional
No stored reviewer JWT or static Vault token.
Other namespaces cannot assume these Vault roles.
Vault KV supplies values; ESO refreshes every minute.
Real target Secrets use Orphan / Retain policies.
SOPS files are encrypted recovery copies.
The public Argo CLI client has no client secret.
Vault uses local Raft and manual Shamir unseal (3 of 5 shares); keep recovery custody independent of the lab host.
